FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF PHYSICS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160 014 (INDIA)
Phone: ++91-172-2541741
Email: physics@pu.ac.in
PHS/_____________ Date : 25/07/2024
(J.R.F / Project fellow Position in Experimental Nuclear Physics)
Applications are invited for the position of a JRF/ Project Fellow in Experimental Nuclear Physics to work in a
IUAC, New Delhi research project entitled “Neutron multiplicity measurements along Hg region”. The
experiments will be performed primarily at the IUAC, New Delhi accelerator facility. The selected fellow will also
get opportunities to participate in various other experiments of the group. The fellow is expected to work both at
Panjab University and various national accelerator laboratories. Further information about the position can be
obtained by E-Mail from Dr. B.R. Behera (bivash@pu.ac.in).
Fellowship: The fellowship amount varies depending on the qualification of the
appointed JRF/ Project fellow under the said project.
JRF-NET/GATE Qualification: If he/she has cleared NET/GATE the fellowship will be higher.
NET/GATE qualified persons will be paid fellowship of Rs. 25000/-
per month for two years and then after for the third and final year will
be Rs. 28000/- per month. The person to be considered for the
appointment of Junior Research fellow (Duration 03 years) must have
NET / Valid GATE score in physics, Master degree with a minimum
55% marks for general category (50% in case of SC/ST/PH) in physics.
The age of JRF should be below 40 years at the time of appointment.
Project fellow –(Non NET/GATE): The Project Fellow should be (minimum) Post Graduate in M.Sc.
Physics. M.Sc. Physics JRF will get Rs. 14000/- per month for two
years and for the third and final year fellowship will be 16000/- per
month. Master degree with a minimum of 55% marks for general
category (50% in case of SC/ST/PH) in physics. The age of JRF should
be below 40 years at the time of appointment. .
How to apply: Apply on plain paper by registered/speed post to the undersigned with
bio-data (matriculation onwards) accompanied by attested copies of
your Certificates / Degrees. Kindly mention the above project title,
your detail contact address, E-Mail. Cell No, Telephone no. etc.
Applications via Email will not be accepted. No TA/DA shall be paid
for attending the interview. M.Sc. batch of 2024 can also apply,
However, they have to submit detailed result on the date of interview.
Last date: 30/08/2024
(Dr. B.R. Behera)
Principal Investigator
